name: SVN
description: Subversion in Orca: see a working copy's changes, then update, commit, revert, add, resolve and diff from a sidebar panel.

cover.alt: SVN for Orca: the SVN changes panel, the SVN History revision tree and the SVN Diff viewer side by side.

screenshots.alt: SVN panel showing a conflicted file, modified, added and deleted files with checkboxes, a commit message and a warning that the server has newer revisions.
screenshots.caption: Changes, conflicts and commit in the sidebar

screenshots.alt: SVN History panel drawing trunk and three branches as coloured lanes with branch points, a merge, tags, and details for revision r4184.
screenshots.caption: Revision tree with branches, merges and tags

screenshots.alt: SVN Diff editor tab showing three changed files as cards with old and new line numbers and green and red changed lines.
screenshots.caption: Diffs open in a full editor tab
